name: wallet_sdk
_comment_version_1_9_0: 1.8.0 -> 1.9.0: card auto-billing (Ray, 2026-10-17). Top-up gains "Pay with a new card": the wallet backend's start_card_checkout (no Order) opens PayFast's hosted checkout (a server-signed form posted from CardCheckoutPage, passphrase never in the app) or Paystack's page; the wallet is credited only when the gateway confirms to the server (get_card_checkout_status polls). "Save this card for automatic renewals" is off until ticked and shows the consent text (renewals charged automatically, no reminder, how to remove the card); it sends consent_version 2026-10-17, which the server records on the card. The wallet history page shows saved cards with a remove button (SavedCardsSection), and every row opens WalletRowDetailSheet, with a static WalletHistoryPage.rowDetailBuilder seam a home SDK fills (lms_sdk: the billing record behind a subscription payment). New tr_keys declared below, read through WalletTrKeys, with bundled English registered by the wallet-en-bundled-translations boot hook; no base_sdk change needed. New direct dependency webview_flutter ^4.10.0 (base_sdk's pin). Needs the matching wallet backend (start_card_checkout, get_card_checkout_status, recurring_consent on get_saved_cards); against an older backend the new-card button answers the friendly failure line and nothing is charged.
_comment_version_1_8_0: 1.7.3 -> 1.8.0: top-up drops the "pay with new card" path (no card-capture flow exists; it pushed a card list that crashed without the orders SDK) and preselects the default card; top-up and phone send send an X-Idempotency-Key (needs the matching wallet backend, which wraps process_wallet_top_up and send_wallet_balance in @idempotent); a successful top-up or send refetches the profile so the wallet card shows the new balance; amounts use the backend currency symbol (rand fallback). Adds dio as a direct dependency.
_comment_version_1_7_0: 1.6.6 -> 1.7.0: the wallet history page runs the REAL fetch in a demo session (Ray, 2026-09-25). WalletSdkDependencies registers DemoFixtures.registerAssetDirectory('assets/demo/wallet'); base_sdk 1.73.0's DemoGatewayInterceptor answers users_sdk's api.user.get_wallet_history from templates/assets/demo/wallet (the same five-row ledger, net +R 793.00). DemoWalletHistory and the page's DemoSession branches are deleted. Needs base_sdk 1.73.0.
_comment_version_1_6_6: 1.6.5 -> 1.6.6: dark-mode sweep - receive-screen amount chips and the active claim card use AppStyle.cardFor(brightness) instead of a fixed white fill.
_comment_version_1_6_5: 1.6.4 -> 1.6.5: Ray's 2026-09-23 notes. The Send sheet follows the app's light/dark mode (fills, ink, borders and the typed text resolve from the inherited theme's brightness via base_sdk's explicit-brightness seams, base_sdk >= 1.66.7); before, it was pinned light and the typed text came out white. Top-up now opens as a modal sheet like Send, from both the profile wallet card and the history page (WalletTopUpPage(asSheet: true) / WalletTopUpPage.showAsSheet); the /wallet-topup route keeps the page form for other callers.
_comment_requires: wallet_sdk >= 1.2.0 requires base_sdk >= 1.33.0 (BaseWalletCard `wallet` param + fixed compile). The composer manifest schema has no machine-readable minimum-version field, so this is the declaration.

boot_hooks._comment: Registers wallet_sdk's bundled English for its manifest tr_keys (card auto-billing copy: the new-card button, the automatic-renewal consent, saved cards, the row detail sheet) into base_sdk's BundledTranslations at boot, the lms_sdk / auth_sdk pattern. Backend-served rows still win; these keys name their strings, so the humanized-key fallback would not read well.

di_hooks._comment: Registers the 'wallet.card' profile section (base_sdk's BaseWalletCard composed with this SDK's history/top-up routes and Send sheet) with base_sdk's ProfileSectionRegistry - the wallet card base_sdk's GenericProfilePage renders on any composed profile route. Declared top-level, NOT in an app_type flavor block, mirroring marketplace_sdk's marketplace-profile-sections hook. Configuration rides WalletCardSection's static seam (visible / symbol / extraActions / showActions), set by a home SDK's own di_hook. Order 20 leaves room for a lower-order home-SDK hook to configure the seam before registration - though the builder and gate also re-read the seam on every page mount, so a later hook still takes effect. Requires base_sdk >= 1.23.0 (the profile host) and >= 1.33.0 (BaseWalletCard `wallet` param).

_comment_routes: /wallet-topup is the exact path lms_sdk's subscribe surface pushes beside its insufficient-funds refusal (agent PR #150, pushNamed('/wallet-topup')); rename only in lockstep with that caller. /wallet-history is the wallet card's history arrow target (WalletProfileCard pushes it by path, guarded).
_comment_app_routes: wallet_sdk owns the /wallet-history page, so it implements base_sdk's AppRoutes.pushWalletHistoryRoute seam (called from commerce marketplace_sdk's profile page; route-map row 25, fix-wave 2026-09-02). Before this entry the host's _HostAppRoutes had no such method and the seam threw noSuchMethod's StateError. The body targets the WalletHistoryRoute that the `routes` block above already declares (WalletHistoryRouteView's only argument is defaulted, so the no-arg constructor is valid); update_app_routes() injects it into main.dart's @generated-approutes block with the default `BuildContext context` params, matching the seam signature. Declared top-level (this manifest has no app_type flavour blocks), mirroring auth_sdk's replaceLoginRoute. Do not declare a second WalletHistoryRoute anywhere: commerce marketplace_sdk still carries a WalletHistoryPage copy and this SDK's route is the canonical one.
